description: This file defines a scraper function for extracting recipe data from BBC food recipe web pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract specific recipe details such as image, name, ingredients, instructions, preparation and cooking times, and servings. The function is exported for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: bbc
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches and parses a BBC recipe webpage to extract recipe details, returning a Promise that resolves with a Recipe object or rejects with an error.
